final: WITH c AS (SELECT d.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id GROUP BY d.account_id, a.frequency), f AS (SELECT frequency, SUM(cnt) AS s FROM c GROUP BY frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(s) AS avg_s FROM f) SELECT f.frequency, f.s, f.s - m.avg_s AS diff FROM f JOIN m ON m.avg_s IS NOT NULL WHERE f.s > m.avg_s ORDER BY f.frequency
